allowed_inputs: calendar date and frozen event window needed to adjudicate candidate-only territorial behavior
independent public or institutional evidence specific to candidate coordinates
forbidden_inputs: prior contaminated control adjudication notes or snippets
matching scores as a reason to alter evidence standards
independent_review_boundary.web_search_policy: If external search is used, queries must be derived only from candidate coordinates/candidate code plus the frozen event date; no target names or target evidence may be included.
independent_review_boundary.reviewer_separation: Review must be performed in a process/context that has not observed sealed target outcomes or contaminated adjudication material.

adjudication.confirmed_control_requires: affirmative independent evidence supporting no activation/impact for that candidate during the frozen event window
adjudication.exclude_activated_requires: affirmative independent evidence of activation/impact for that candidate during the frozen event window

fail_closed: any target name or target outcome enters the reviewer packet or adjudication artifact
review_packet SHA-256 differs from the frozen value
a candidate is labeled CONTROL from documentary silence
candidate membership changes after territorial review
matching is rerun using territorial adjudication
